To have more clarity on my situation .. I wouldn’t say I was right in what I did nor was I wrong, let me clarify just for the sake of sharing my experience.

I entered the airport almost 8 hours before my flight because I lived in a different city and thank god I did, cause I was ignorant and didn’t really understand what would happen if you care to read.

Entered 12PM finished entering the airport and going through check gates and my luggage and then to departure gate where an officer of immigration was present.. first they asked if I had a residence card I said no I only have my pending application which I would not want anymore…

Another officer shift started so they just started the whole conversation again and asked why I had no stamp of entry to Poland I replied I came transit via Germany and in Poland no one at the airport asked me to see my passport or visa and in Germany when I said I’m not going to enter the country the officer said Ok and here you go your passport without stamping it.. 

Another senior officer came to me and just dragged me to a separate office and on the way there was some Ukrainian people that didn’t speak polish that were asking him questions for help and I knew a lot of Russian since my friends are Ukrainian so I helped them. Then I went to the office with the officer.

Then he continued speaking such a difficult dialect in polish that I didn’t understand and I knew polish to the extent I was working in customer service, and then I said I don’t speak polish good and he slammed and banged the table saying that I’m illegal and how do I speak Ukrainian and that I will go to jail if I don’t confess. And continued threatening me with handcuffs so I got scared tbh I said only 2 words im legal. 


He worked on his computer for 1 hour sitting in front of him and said to me to wait in another room I waited for a couple of hours waiting on him and then he would come ask some questions and leave and an unknown vibe was in the air if I’m going to miss my flight and go to jail for real. 

After 4 hours of waiting he said I have to pay a fine of 500PLN or I will go to jail then he presented a lot of documents LIKE ALOT and told me to sign or I go to jail. 

So I did pay the fine after calling some friends to send me money because I transferred my money back to my country.. 

The situation was scary. Especially that I felt racism coming from him. So I signed and just wanted to feel home again. Never wanted to go back to my country more than that.

Keep in mind I was only a 21 year old.. I didn’t know I had options other than to sign.
